subject: Customer at information desk
parts: a stick figure customer bust on the left and a stick figure attendant bust on the right, each made of one hollow circle head floating a full stroke width above one open shoulder arc, and one hollow rectangular service counter below the attendant with a full stroke width of white space separating it from both busts; all five shapes use bold equally thick strokes and generous gaps
warnings: Best of three generations: strokes remain thinner than the SOLO48 target and head-to-shoulder gaps are tight at 48 px.
